mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_idempotency(idem_key, buyer_id, request_hash, order_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{idemKey}, #{buyerId}, #{requestHash}, #{orderId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM order_idempotency WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND created_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT idem_key FROM order_idempotency WHERE status = 'RESERVING' AND updated_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 100
